text_block_list.text:
One day, I set out with Azuma-san to meet 
someone 
who had offered to give us some old texts— 
but it seemed an unexpected issue had 
cropped up on their end.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Our meeting has been delayed by a few 
hours... 
Perhaps it would be best if we part ways 
for now?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl High Schooler
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! That arcade we always go to 
got a new purikura booth! The photo 
filters are totally insane!

text_block_list.name: Human High Schooler
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Let's grab everyone and head to 
the main strip! 
I'll ping the usual squad on LANE♪

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...How radiant.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
There are words among theirs unfamiliar to 
me... 
Yet their destination must surely be 
a place of great delight to them both.
choice_data_list:
Want to check out the main strip 
ourselves?

Want to check out the main strip 
ourselves?

text_block_list.text:
This neighborhood was a bustling hangout 
for young people. 
For Azuma-san, who rarely visited such 
places, 
it would certainly be a fresh, novel 
experience.
choice_data_list:
It might be fun to sample today's trends 
for a change.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Today's "trends"... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
... 
If so... would you be so kind as to guide 
me?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Let us go together— 
and behold that which makes their young 
hearts flutter.

The boulevard we arrived at was as lively 
as ever, 
packed to the brim with youth.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It is indeed a lively and splendid avenue. 
...What manner of beverage might that 
"cream frappé" over there be?
choice_data_list:
It's sweet and delicious. I'll go buy us 
some!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that shrine maiden cosplay?! 
That's sick! 
So legit! It looks totally amazing on 
you~!!

text_block_list.name: Female Scout
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, your hair is stunning! Would 
you be 
interested in modeling for our hair 
salon~?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This town is overflowing with vigor. 
Merely standing here, 
voices call out from every direction.
choice_data_list: Haha... How does the frappé taste?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It possesses a sweetness distinct from 
traditional confections. 
So this is the flavor 
cherished by the youth of today.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Is it customary etiquette to feed 
each other a sip, 
just as those youths over yonder are 
doing?
choice_data_list:
No, no! That's... a very special kind of 
custom...!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Mechanical contraptions sparkling in every 
color. 
Melodies reminiscent of a festival tune.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
So this is the "geh-sen" 
I overheard spoken of in the park.
choice_data_list: Is there anything catching your eye?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...That thing known as "puri."

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The horsegirls and human children were 
conversing about it with such sheer 
delight, after all.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. 
I cannot partake in this.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I must refrain from leaving behind 
records of my likeness for future 
generations. 
Be it a diminutive photograph, it makes no 
difference.

It's likely some rule of the shrine 
maidens, or something similar. 
Still, seeing her gaze filled with such 
curiosity, 
it felt like a shame for her to miss out.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: A mask...
choice_data_list: Don't you think this could work?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. 
You are quite the resourceful one.
—*Snap!* *Ding-dong♪*

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Once taken, 
one simply inscribes characters onto the 
photo?
choice_data_list: Yes, drawings or any message you like.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ——..."On this day, most precious."

Watching her serene expression as her pen 
glided across, 
I was truly glad I had suggested it.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: —The sun begins to slant low.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It is nearly time for our meeting, isn't 
it? 
How swiftly the hours have passed.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I was able to savor the modern 
"trends" 
that I would never have encountered on my 
own.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And all of this was possible 
because you invited me...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Pleasures of the present realm that shift 
in the blink of an eye. 
I offer my deepest gratitude 
for granting me the chance to touch them 
so.
choice_data_list:
It's nice to do things like this once in a 
while, right?

Unexpectedly, they might end up lasting 
quite a long time.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
Indeed so.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Yet, for one such as myself, it is 
somewhat overwhelming. 
Without you here, Trainer, 
I could never have hoped to even graze its 
surface.
choice_data_list:
If you'll have me, I'm always happy to 
keep you company.

If you'll have me, I'm always happy to 
keep you company.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Your words are most kind... 
Should fate cross our paths again on some 
future day.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. 
It is precisely as you say.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Even long history begins with a single 
step. 
Many steps overlap, 
gradually swelling into a great current.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
If the sights and amusements of that 
street 
shall one day become tradition as well—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
That would be a deeply fascinating 
prospect.

Afterward— 
we met with the book's owner and completed 
the handoff.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Our collection has grown richer once more. 
My thanks for your gracious kindness.

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, not at all! My apologies for 
keeping you waiting. 
Though... it appears you two had a 
wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Does it appear so to you?

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It might just be my imagination, 
but... 
both of your faces look 
thoroughly fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. 
You have hit the mark.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
For today has truly been 
a radiant passage of time.

Today was another thoroughly fulfilling 
day. 
I look forward to writing about it in my 
diary—I thought, 
gazing at Azuma-san's gentle smile.
